name: com.studio.pulse
description: Game analytics SDK for the studio-pulse collector (event contract v2): crash-safe disk queue, batching, gzip, retries with backoff, sessions, install store, level / economy / ad / purchase / settings events, managed errors, consent and opt-out, plus frame-time, memory and load-time telemetry. Pure C# core, thin Unity adapter.

samples.description: Pulse.Init at startup and level, fail position and setting events from game code.
